aiven_attempt.reason: Aiven permits only one free MySQL service for the current account/organization, and that allocation is already consumed.

existing_shared_service.reason: Current RamaVerse preview isolation policy prohibits shared cross-project database services.

provider_portability.reason: The repository can now validate a separately provisioned MySQL/MySQL-compatible service with exact host identity and verified TLS, but an alternative provider has not yet passed live schema/integration QA.

next_valid_paths: Select and provision a separately owned RamaVerse MySQL/MySQL-compatible service on an owner-approved provider/plan/region.
Run the provider-neutral Preview DB Setup gate against that dedicated service.
Load and independently verify canonical Reader rows only through the approved lossless corpus process.
Run the integration and exact deployed-commit QA gates before production consideration.
Change the isolation policy only through an explicit architecture decision with owner approval and corresponding code/test updates.
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not silently reuse hitech-preview-mysql for RamaVerse preview runtime.
Do not label a statically compatible provider as approved before live schema/integration validation.
Do not create a paid service without explicit owner approval of the paid plan and cloud/region.
Do not fabricate database or Reader readiness evidence.
